name: Mailchimp Transactional
description: Mailchimp Transactional is an email-delivery product, formerly known as Mandrill, for application-generated and event-driven messages. Teams use it to send direct or template email and review sending domains, reputation, delivery activity, and aggregate performance.
agentUseSummary: Connect a customer-owned Transactional API key and exact sender boundary, then let agents inspect bounded account and sender state, send approval-gated email, or use the broader documented JSON API under Safe or Dangerous policy. Relay fixes the provider origin, injects and redacts the key server-side, bounds requests and responses, and blocks sender-bypass sends, SMS, raw MIME relay, exports, and credential-bearing input.

evidence.supports: The official fundamentals fix all API calls to mandrillapp.com/api/1.0, require POST JSON, and authenticate by a key field in every request body.
The official quick start says Transactional uses customer-created API keys with full account access, so Relay stores the key encrypted and asks customers to restrict it.
The official message endpoint documents direct transactional email, recipient status results, asynchronous delivery behavior, IP pools, and scheduling up to one year.
The official template endpoint uses immutable template slugs and the same message and delivery controls as direct sending.
The official account endpoint returns user, quota, reputation, and historical sending statistics and can include key material that Relay must redact.
The official sender-domain endpoint returns DKIM, SPF, DMARC, verification, and signing state for the account's domains.
